correctness.rationale: Via vector identification e_i↔T^i in A=K[T]/(T^p−1)=K[u]/u^p, quandle product is f(T^-1)g(T²). Any nonzero augmentation-zero f has u-order r>=1 while f⋆f has order 2r or vanishes; hence only zero augmentation-zero idempotent. Finite exp/log is a bijection J↔1+J in characteristic p; X=log T has leading term u and the substitutions map X to −X and 2X.
